title: 📝Mounts of Mayhem Expansion patch notes
author: Mr_Simba
excerpt: The Runic Shift Event brings a special Rune Rush with increased rune drops, six Tier VI surges, and research opportunities for new spear enchantments! The Valor Shop introduces two powerful spear relics, Messina and G.A.M.M.A., while Runecrafting receives major updates to the Paradigms of Lust, Wrath, and Vainglory.
body:
🪄Runic Shift Event

  • ⏫A Rune Rush will replace the March 7th - 8th Ominous Rush. This grants +25% rune drops and causes fully failed Runecrafts to return 3 runes.

  • 🕰️Six Tier VI surges will run automatically at the following times(PDT):

    • March 7, 2026 10:00 AM

    • March 7, 2026 3:00 PM

    • March 7, 2026 8:00 PM

    • March 8, 2026 10:00 AM

    • March 8, 2026 3:00 PM

    • March 8, 2026 8:00 AM

  • 🪛Defeated Tier VI apexes drop an Attuned Boundary Fragment which uncovers the research project of a new spear enchantment once given to the Arcanum.

  • 💎Defeated Tier V apexes drop a standard Boundary Fragment which can be submitted for 50% research project progress.

  • 📜The research quest for these projects will reroll immediately upon completion.

🛡️Valor Shop: Spear Relics

  • 🦑Messina, a new hybrid which starts as the trident Charybdis:

    • 🪛Charybdis has the mythical trajectory enchant Whirlpool🌟. It leaves Scylla behind in-hand when thrown.

      • Whirlpool🌟: Throws fly straight and pull enemies, then slam down and form a suffocating whirlpool.

    • 🪛Scylla is a diamond spear with no minimum attack range and with the mythical dash enchant Man-Eater🌟. Charybdis can be collected, replacing Scylla, once no enemies are in its whirlpool.

      • Man-Eater🌟: Charges forcibly dash to Charybdis, briefly liquefying terrain. Jabs near the whirlpool pull in enemies and execute at 10% HP, sating 1 hunger.

  • ☢️G.A.M.M.A., a diamond spear with the mythical loot enchant Cyclotron 🌟. While moving very fast, drops are atomized, often converting to a Primordial Dust.

📖Runecrafting: Paradigm Updates

  • ❤️‍🔥Paradigm of Lust: (Buff) Scorn leap range strongly increased. Attacking scorned targets heals your defended ally.

  • 🤬Paradigm of Wrath: (Rework) Your swing becomes a rapid onslaught using all melee hotbar weapons, but your hotbar must all be melee weapons for strikes to land.

    • Onslaught attacks have 2x speed and ignore mercy frames.

  • 🪞Paradigm of Vainglory: (Rework) Your swings fire as piercing waves, and you can hover at full health, but you strike yourself, bypassing armor, when your waves miss.

    • Hover: Swing directly up to toggle the hover. It disables once you witness your health fall below full.
